# Micle

> Micle is a free, daily Wordle-style guessing game where players identify a studio microphone by comparing six attributes — manufacturer, country of origin, operating principle, polar pattern, release year, and price — against the correct answer in six guesses or fewer. A "Random Mic" practice mode offers unlimited unscored rounds from the same real recording-studio equipment inventory.

## Details
- One shared daily puzzle (like Wordle), plus unlimited practice mode.
- Mic pool sourced from a real professional recording studio's microphone inventory (Berklee College of Music).
- No account, no login, no ads; game state (stats/streak) lives only in the player's browser via localStorage.

## Site
- [Play Micle](https://micle.julianro.se/): the game itself, always shows today's puzzle.
